defect: event preservation depends on an unstated minimum spacing between source pulses
rationale: The toggle synchronizer is structurally sound for separated pulses, but no environment contract limits how soon src_pulse_i may recur. Two source pulses before the destination observes the first can cancel in the toggle and lose an event, so the design cannot be classified without that assumption.

mutation.description: Removed the source-side pulse-spacing guarantee documented for prim_pulse_sync.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the pulse synchronizer but left source event spacing unconstrained.
